honesty.convention: these shapes are a convention this bundle invented, not a standard anyone else uses; the legend is in the wiki and on the page rather than assumed.
honesty.presentation_only: focus is presentation. Looking at a label changes nothing: no label is a score, none gates anything, and no grader reads which sign a learner faced.
honesty.provenance: a dashed outline on a SCHEMATIC sign and a solid accent on a RECORDED one restate the claim the registry behind them already makes - the label never upgrades a claim.
honesty.legibility: a label never shrinks below the declared floor while it is in range, carries a shadow so it survives a bright sky, and is drawn at device pixel ratio so it is not soft on a phone.
honesty.reduced_motion: viewers who ask for reduced motion keep the shapes and the colours and lose the easing: labels sit at full opacity rather than breathing as the head turns.

speech.draws: a rounded bubble with a tail pointing down at the speaker
speech.reads_as: somebody who will answer a question

tab.draws: a rounded plate with a downward pointer
tab.reads_as: a place you can go into

chip.reads_as: a thing you can open or pick up

plate.draws: a chamfered rectangle with a left accent stripe
plate.reads_as: a room, or a part of a place you are already in

pin.draws: a plate on a stem ending in a dot

banner.draws: a wide bar with a heavy left accent stripe

marquee.draws: a large plate with a rule above the title and letter-spaced caps
marquee.reads_as: the name of the whole place

ghost.draws: no plate at all - text with a shadow, so it does not compete with what it labels
ghost.reads_as: a detail, there if you look

readout.draws: a dark bordered box in monospace

type.note: display for names, body for the line under them, mono for anything a machine measured - three faces, three ranks, and no fourth

campus.what: the name of a campus, over its plaza

district.what: a district of halls, over its block

hall.what: a hall you can walk into

advisor.what: somebody standing there who will answer questions

crib.what: a tool crib you can open

fixture.what: a bench or a piece of kit, named quietly

anchor.what: a real place, at its recorded distance and bearing

schematic.what: a drawn place - the dashed outline is the claim

route.what: a distance between two recorded points

readout.what: a measured number, from a seat or a chart

focus.contract: each frame a label is scored 0..1 on the angle between the view direction and the label, inside the declared cone, and again on distance relative to how far out the view is; the two are multiplied. The score drives opacity (never below the floor while in range), size and tint, and it is eased rather than snapped so nothing flickers as the head turns.

screen.note: a fraction of viewport height, applied after the focus grow, so the clamp is what the eye finally sees

focus.focus_rule: the single most centred label within reach is the FOCUS: it takes the accent tint and lifts by lift_m, so a learner can see what they are about to act on without a cursor - which is what makes this work in a headset, where there is no cursor to have.
